The 'plate ii' image (§3, 'the name, on all nine') is muddy and low-legibility; it depends almost entirely on its caption to communicate, so as pure pixels it underperforms the rest of the page.
The final dark section repeats the hero's dark-field + Didone + amber formula rather than evolving it, so the close feels like a reprise instead of a new compositional statement.
what_works: Decisive type system: a genuine high-contrast Didone display (André / Macedo at enormous scale) set against a lowercase monospace utility voice for section markers (§1 · boulevard du temple, paris, 1838) — exactly the editorial-serif-vs-mono pairing a template generator avoids.

The entire page is built on one committed conceptual frame — Daguerre's long-exposure, the arc-of-sun light trail, 'nine faces on one plate', 'generation 256' — carried through graphics, numbering and copy, not pasted on. That is a real signature.
Asymmetric hero: name anchored top-left over black, amber light-trail arc pushed right with off-axis mono annotations floating in the field — tension and compositional mass, not centered symmetry.
Restrained three-value palette (near-black, cream, single amber accent) held consistently; italic emphasis ('stood still', 'comes back') used sparingly as the only decorative flourish.
Stranger test is fully satisfied in the first viewport: name, two-company one-liner, and a visible 'write me@andremacedo.com' all legible without scrolling.
A.reasoning: This is unmistakably not a SaaS template — no centered hero, no gradient, no three-card row; instead a dark editorial masthead with a high-contrast Didone against a monospace margin voice and a single amber accent, all organized by an extended Daguerre long-exposure conceit that drives graphics, numbering and copy. The hero is a resolved asymmetric system rather than a floating headline, type_craft and the conceptual through-line are the decisive signature moves, and the stranger test clears its floor with name, role and email above the fold. Minor softness in the generative star-trail and the muddy plate image keeps it from a higher score, but nothing triggers a cardinal slop state.
